# Temple Scroll Column 60 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 60 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**60:1** And innocent blood shall not be shed in the midst of your land which the LORD your God is giving to you as an inheritance, and blood-guilt shall not be upon you.

**60:2** But if a man is hating his neighbor and lies-in-wait for him and rises against him and strikes him — a soul — and he dies, and he flees to one of these cities,

**60:3** then the elders of his city shall send and take him from there and give him into the hand of the redeemer of blood, and he shall die.

**60:4** Your eye shall not show-pity upon him, and you shall burn out the innocent blood from Israel, and it shall go well with you.

**60:5** You shall not remove the boundary-marker of your neighbor which the former-ones set, in your inheritance which you inherit in the land that the LORD your God is giving to you to possess it.

**60:6** One witness shall not rise against a man for any iniquity or for any sin, in any sin which he sins; upon the mouth of two witnesses or upon the mouth of three witnesses a matter shall be established.

**60:7** If a malicious witness rises against a man to testify against him a turning-aside,

**60:8** then the two men to whom the dispute belongs shall stand before the LORD, before the priests and the judges who shall be in those days.

**60:9** And the judges shall investigate well, and behold, the witness is a false witness; falsehood he testified against his brother.

**60:10** Then you shall do to him as he plotted to do to his brother, and you shall burn out the evil from your midst.

**60:11** And the rest shall hear and fear, and they shall not continue to do again according to this evil thing in your midst.

**60:12** And your eye shall not show-pity: soul for soul, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.

**60:13** When you go out to war against your enemies and you see horse and chariot, a people more numerous than you, you shall not fear them, for the LORD your God is with you, who brought you up from the land of Egypt.

**60:14** And it shall be, when you draw near to the battle, the priest shall approach and speak to the people.

**60:15** And he shall say to them: Hear, O Israel, you are drawing near today to battle against your enemies; let your heart not be faint; do not fear and do not tremble and do not be-terrified before them.

**60:16** For the LORD your God is the one going with you, to fight for you against your enemies, to save you.

---

*EMET notes: Column 60 reworks Deuteronomy 19:10-20:4. "Redeemer of blood" (go'el ha-dam) preserved literally. "Turning-aside" (sarah) for the false testimony charge. The lex talionis formula (60:12) preserved in full. The war-priest's speech (60:14-16) retains the four-fold prohibition: "do not fear, do not tremble, do not be terrified." "Boundary-marker" for gevul — the ancient property marker. The transition from judicial to military law follows the Deuteronomic sequence.*
